items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is ACTIVE. Risk/reward RB2 but starting everywhere; wouldn't activate if worried about injury though Cardinals risk remains.
items.why: Expected to play per reports; official active list.
items.implication: Unquestioned lead back; start in all formats with risk.

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze (calf) officially ACTIVE vs Panthers. Expected to play after limited practices; plans to go.
items.implication: Full WR1 role with Burden; monitor snap share.

items.text: Malik Nabers (knee) murky/up-to-him for SNF; main slate locked otherwise. Giants elevated Berrios and Cambre from PS. Projections updating only for this.
items.why: Practiced fully but status personal decision; elevations signal caution.
items.implication: If out, Berrios/Cambre upside; if in, full WR1.
items.opportunity: Monitor for confirmation; reverse beneficiaries if active

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (knee/MCL) is not expected to play and officially inactive vs Lions. Full participant late week but not ready; progressed faster than expected but held out.
items.why: MCL sprain; sources confirm not ready despite full practice Friday.
items.implication: Etienne unchallenged lead back; Miller RB2.

items.text: Ravens ruled out WR Ja'Kobi Lane due to wrist injury.
items.implication: BAL WR depth chart shift; Flowers/others more targets.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps for remaining Ravens WRs

items.text: Start Jeremiyah Love everywhere as risk/reward RB2 now that ACTIVE.
items.why: Active confirmation reduces injury worry; lead role.

items.text: Patriots WR AJ Brown high ankle sprain: no surgery needed but sidelined 4-6 weeks.
items.why: High ankle; conservative timeline no surgery.
items.implication: NE WR depth elevated long-term; sit/IR candidate.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers OUT after meniscus trim Tuesday; realistic chance miss only one game and return Week 2 at Chargers. Team to monitor feeling this week.
items.implication: Mayer elevated TE1 role Week 1; Bowers stash for quick return.

items.text: Kamara's inactive status boosts projection for Travis Etienne and Saints RBs.
Bucs activated Josh Williams; Sean Tucker doubtful. Impacts TB RB shares with Irving/Gainwell.
items.opportunity: Higher snap/carry share for Irving and Gainwell

items.text: Sunday AM summary: Love/Odunze expected (now active), Kamara not (inactive), Nabers no news (murky), Josh Williams activated (Tucker doubtful).
items.why: Aggregated weekend reports for inactive window.
items.implication: Core Sunday monitoring complete for main slate.
items.opportunity: Act on confirmed statuses for lineups

items.text: Rams DE Myles Garrett arthroscopic knee surgery, placed on IR; misses min 4 games (Giants, Broncos, Eagles, Bills). Possible Aaron Donald return next.
Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr. officially inactive (back) vs Falcons; trade possibility remains amid contract dispute.
items.implication: Secondary impact; limited fantasy unless IDP.

items.text: Main-slate news largely locked; no major projection changes expected beyond Nabers. Projections live and updating.
items.why: Statuses settled for 1pm; only SNF variable.
items.implication: Trust current ETR numbers except Nabers contingency.

items.text: Chuba Hubbard viable flex; keeping open this week.
items.why: Viable option amid CAR RB committee.
items.implication: Flex consideration depending on other statuses.

items.text: Week 1 pace: NO@DET up-tempo; MIA@LV slow slog. Full snaps/pace available.
items.implication: Higher play volume NO-DET favors skill players; lower MIA-LV.
